summary: Emerson Electric filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a €750 million offering of 4.000% notes due November 13, 2032, priced at 99.639% of par for gross proceeds of €747.3 million and net proceeds of €744.5 million after a 0.375% underwriting discount. Interest accrues from the November 13, 2026 settlement and pays annually; the notes are redeemable before maturity at described prices. Joint book-runners include J.P. Morgan, Citigroup, BofA, Goldman Sachs, HSBC and others. This is a routine investment-grade debt takedown, not a special situation; watch for NYSE listing and use of proceeds.
